description: Agent-based, network-embedded social influence and market-environment model of mask-wearing adoption with information campaigns, policy enforcement, supply constraints, and optional disease transmission.

modules.name: InformationCampaignModule
modules.description: Applies public health campaigns and media messages to update individuals' risk perception, trust, and policy awareness.

notes: Risk updates occur on messaging days; info_decay_rate damps accumulation.
Policy awareness increments when exposed to public health messaging.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceAndDecisionModule
modules.description: Computes social influence from network neighbors, households, and venues; updates attitudes and decides daily mask use via logistic choice.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  # observe social norms
  neighbor_mask_mean = mean(mask_use of i.social_neighbors)
  household_norm = Household[i.home_id].norms_strength
  workplace_norm = mean(mask_use of contacts at i.workplace_id) if present else 0
  # attitude update: bounded confidence with stubbornness
  delta_att = influence_strength * (
    conformity_weight * neighbor_mask_mean + household_norms_weight * household_norm + workplace_norms_weight * workplace_norm
  ) - i.stubbornness * 0.1
  # integrate risk perception sensitivity
  delta_att += risk_perception_sensitivity * (i.risk_perception - 0.5)
  i.mask_attitude = clamp(i.mask_attitude + delta_att, -5, 5)
  # perceived cost updates (price and inconvenience)
  inconvenience = Normal(perceived_cost_mask_base, mask_disutility_sd)
  i.perceived_cost_mask = clamp(inconvenience, 0, 5)
  # decision: logistic choice with policy and inventory constraints
  policy_active = PolicyEnforcementModule.policy_active
  x = (decision_logit_intercept
       + decision_logit_beta_attitude * i.mask_attitude
       + decision_logit_beta_policy * (policy_active * i.policy_awareness)
       + decision_logit_beta_cost * i.perceived_cost_mask
       + decision_logit_beta_risk * i.risk_perception
      ) + LogisticNoise(scale=decision_noise_scale)
  p_wear = sigmoid(x)
  # cannot wear if no mask and no access
  if i.mask_inventory <= 0 and i.access_to_masks < 0.5:
    i.mask_use = 0
  else:
    i.mask_use = Bernoulli(p_wear)
notes: Attitude is a latent continuous variable; decision is binary each day.
Household and workplace norms provide additional social context.

modules.name: PolicyEnforcementModule
modules.description: Manages mask mandates, enforcement intensity, fines, and denial of entry for noncompliance.

notes: A simple scheduled mandate; thresholds could be added by comparing daily infections to thresholds.
Enforcement resources scale can modulate enforcement_level if needed.

modules.name: RetailMarketModule
modules.description: Simulates mask supply with inventory dynamics, rationing, and dynamic pricing; processes purchases.

update_rule.pseudocode:
# Restock and price update per retailer r
for each retailer r:
  restock_amount = Poisson(retailer_restock_rate_per_day * desired_inventory_target)
  if Bernoulli(stockout_probability):
    restock_amount = 0
  r.inventory_level += restock_amount
  demand_pressure = (yesterday_demand_r + 1) / (r.inventory_level + 1)
  price_multiplier = 1 + dynamic_pricing_elasticity * clamp(demand_pressure - 1, 0, 5)
  r.price = mask_price_base * price_multiplier
# Purchase phase per person i
for each person i:
  desired = max(0, desired_inventory_target - i.mask_inventory)
  if desired > 0 and i.access_to_masks > 0.5:
    chosen_retailer = argmin_r(distance_cost + r.price / (1 + price_sensitivity_to_income * SES_income_multiplier(i)))
    purchasable = min(desired, rationing_max_units_per_purchase, chosen_retailer.inventory_level)
    if purchasable > 0:
      chosen_retailer.inventory_level -= purchasable
      i.mask_inventory += purchasable
      record transaction with price r.price and quantity purchasable
emit stockout flag if r.inventory_level == 0
notes: Rationing caps per-visit purchases to mitigate hoarding.

modules.name: MobilityAndVenueModule
modules.description: Assigns daily mobility, workplace attendance, and public space visits; generates contacts and observed norms.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  attend_work = Bernoulli(i.mobility_rate)
  visits_public = Poisson(mobility_rate_mean * 0.5)
  record entry attempts for policy enforcement
# Contacts within venues
for each workplace w:
  attendees = sampled persons assigned to w with attend_work == 1
  contacts = sample_pairs(attendees, WorkplaceSchool.contact_rate)
  WorkplaceSchool.mask_use_observed[w] = mean(mask_use over attendees)
for each public space s:
  visitors = sampled persons by capacity and visits_public
  contacts = sample_pairs(visitors, contact_rate_per_day * ventilation_effect_on_contacts)
  PublicSpace.mask_use_observed[s] = mean(mask_use over visitors)
emit contacts.daily_pairs
notes: Observed mask use in venues feeds back into SocialInfluence.

modules.name: DiseaseTransmissionModule
modules.description: Optional SIR-like disease spread accounting for mask efficacy at contact level and recovery.

notes: This module can be disabled by setting baseline_transmission_prob to 0.
Averted infections computed as cumulative(no-mask) - cumulative(actual).

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily adoption statistics and computes windowed summaries.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily = mean(Person.mask_use)
adoption_by_ses_daily = {low: mean(mask_use where SES=low), mid: ..., high: ...}
average_mask_price_daily = mean(Retailer.price weighted by transactions)
stockout_frequency_daily = mean(1[Retailer.inventory_level == 0])
infections_daily = time_series.infections_daily
policy_active_flag = PolicyEnforcementModule.policy_active
infections_averted_cumulative = cum_sum(counterfactual.infections_nomask - infections_daily)
notes: All observables updated daily for metric computation.
Price averaging should use transaction-weighted mean; fallback to retailer mean if no transactions.

algorithms.NetworkGeneration: Watts-Strogatz small-world network (networkx.watts_strogatz_graph) with avg_degree and rewiring_prob.
algorithms.LogisticChoice: Daily binary mask-use decision via logistic function with stochastic noise.
algorithms.BoundedConfidence: Attitude updates blend social norms, risk perception, and personal stubbornness with clamping.
algorithms.DynamicPricing: Retail pricing adjusts with demand pressure relative to inventory.
algorithms.InventoryRestock: Poisson restocking modulated by stockout_probability shocks.
algorithms.VenueContactSampling: Random pair sampling within venues proportional to venue contact parameters and ventilation.
algorithms.DiscreteSIR: Daily per-contact transmission with mask efficacy attenuation; deterministic recovery after mean duration.
